posts.title: Build Your Own Tailscale: A Self-Hosted Headscale Mesh with Docker and Nginx
posts.description: I wanted one thing: open opengym.nas.local on my laptop, from anywhere, without exposing a single port of my NAS to the internet. Tailscale does this beautifully, but its control server is a service somebody else runs. Headscale is an open-source implementation of that control server. posts.title: Put the Answer First, Nobody Has Time for Your Story
posts.description: Most people communicate like they write a detective novel. First the setup, then the clues, then the big reveal at the end. Your audience doesn’t want that.
